title: AS2: assignment-as-expression returns undefined instead of assigned value
description: In packages/core/src/as2/compiler.ts at lines 1642, 1661, 1698, 1716, assignment used as a sub-expression (e.g. while ((line = readLine()) != null)) yields undefined instead of the assigned value. The compiler emits a Set action but does not duplicate the value on the stack first. Fix: before emitting ActionSetVariable/ActionSetMember/etc in assignment-expression context, dup the value so it remains on the stack after the set.
